name: kinetic-center-build
title: Kinetic Center Build
description: Words enter from the right and push the growing phrase left until the final line locks centered.
author: Remocn

syncPoints.description: Calibrated to the default three-word text; custom word counts change the lock time.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Short phrase that builds one word at a time.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer phrases shrink to stay inside the frame.

variables.label: Entry offset
variables.description: Horizontal distance each new word travels before it lands.

variables.label: Color
variables.description: Text color for the full phrase.

variables.label: Font weight
variables.description: Weight used by every word in the phrase.
